items.title: Reconcile migration milestone IDs
items.context: Keep CP-0 inventory and CP-1..CP-5 names as canonical and align existing migration constants.
items.userSees: User sees: grep CP-0..CP-5 in milestones.ts returns only canonical IDs CP-0, CP-1, CP-2, CP-3, CP-4, CP-5.

happy.desc: Canonical migration constants expose CP-0 through CP-5 consistently.

edge.desc: Unknown or stale milestone IDs are rejected before migration writes.

adversarial.desc: Re-run with legacy aliases and confirm canonical IDs are still validated.

items.title: Align StoryControlStatus and ProjectControlStatus with documented schema
items.context: Adopt runtime/consumption/queue/readiness fields and aggregate lanes while preserving compatibility fields used by existing consumers.
items.userSees: User sees: StoryControlStatus serialization includes runtime, consumption, queue, readiness fields and optional legacy lane fields when needed.

happy.desc: StoryControlStatus and ProjectControlStatus include canonical runtime/consumption/queue/readiness fields.

edge.desc: Legacy lane/queue fields remain available via compatibility projection.

adversarial.desc: Malformed or conflicting fields are rejected by schema mapping and do not alter behavior.

items.title: Update lifecycle-control smoke assertions and exports
items.context: Refresh source-structure convergence smoke to validate the canonical status shape and new milestone count.
items.userSees: User sees: source-structure-convergence-smoke output includes `StoryControlStatus schema` and `milestoneCount=6` assertions.

happy.desc: Smoke verifies canonical status shape, CP-0..CP-5, and no legacy-only fields in strict mode.

edge.desc: Smoke can intentionally surface old-schema mismatch with readable diagnostic.

adversarial.desc: Partial migration scenario fails early and logs explicit mismatch details.

items.title: Document compatibility policy in code comments and docs
items.context: Make explicit which fields are canonical and which are compatibility projections to avoid future drift.
items.userSees: User sees explicit comments in architecture/docs marking canonical fields and compatibility-only fields in lifecycle-control status shapes.

happy.desc: Documentation and inline comments distinguish canonical fields vs compatibility projections.

edge.desc: Compat-only fields are only documented as optional/read-through layers and not treated as core semantics.

adversarial.desc: Automated scope audit can detect omitted canonical/compatibility markers.
